verdict.rationale: CloudConvert is a hosted service. Its pricing page offers 10 free conversions per day with no credit card, and its Job Builder lets users try out conversion requests through a graphical web interface, which suggests one-off conversions can run without installing anything. However, no evidence explicitly describes a browser upload-convert-download flow for end users; the Job Builder is framed as an API request tool. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the browser-based conversion UI, confirmation that no installs or sign-up are needed for a one-off job, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
